out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels in the employee bathroom
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED PAPER TOWELS IN THE BATHROOM.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 4DWR prep top: pizza sauce (54f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED THE PIZZA SAUCE INTO THE WALK-IN FREEZER TO CHILL TO 41f.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: Observed several cracked plastic tote boxes being used to store food (cheese, mushrooms, chicken)
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO REPLACE PLASTIC TOTES WITH MORE DURABLE FOOD SAFE CONTAINERS. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) observed a container of Raw chicken being stored over shredded cheese in the walk-in
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW CHICKEN TO THE BOTTOM SHELF NEXT TO RAW CHICKEN.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed three spray bottles of glue and cleaning products being stored on the top shelf above the paper products and commercial condiments
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED THE CHEMICAL SPRAY BOTTLES TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA BY THE BACK DOOR.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed mouse dropping under a prep table
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CLEAN MORE FREQUENTLY. PIC STATES THAT THEIR PEST CONTROL COMPANY STILL COMES WEEKLY/REGULARLY. ELIMINATE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS TO REDUCE PEST PRESENCES.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: A box of pizza peels were observed being stored directly on the ground under the pizza oven
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE PIZZA PEELS TO FACILITATE CLEANING AND REDUCE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS. PIC MOVED PIZZA PEELS TO THE PREP TABLE. PIZZA BOLIS RESTON (Inspection Date: 02/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: Observed large and medium sized non-food grade totes being used to store food throughout the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. REPLACE WITH NSF-APPROVED FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: Observed cardboard boxes being used as shelf liners. Observed pizza peels being stored in a cardboard box.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVED ALL CARDBOARD LINERS TO REDUCE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS AND TO ENCOURAGE ROUTINE CLEANING. DISCONTINUE USING CARDBOARD BOXES TO HOLD PIZZA PEALS.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The faucet of the 3 compartment sink was observed leaking when in use
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAIR LEAK.
